Responsibilities DFIR - Windows, macOS, Linux & Cloud Lead DFIR investigations across Windows, macOS and Linux endpoints/servers, identifying attack vectors, persistence mechanisms, lateral movement and root cause. Perform disk, memory, file-system, registry and artifact analysis to reconstruct attacker activity and establish timelines. Analyze Windows artifacts including Event Logs, Registry, Prefetch, Amcache, Shimcache, SRUM, PowerShell, scheduled tasks and browser artifacts. Investigate macOS artifacts including Unified Logs, LaunchAgents/LaunchDaemons, persistence mechanisms, shell history, browser data and file-system activity. Perform timeline analysis and artifact correlation to reconstruct attacker behavior and determine the scope and impact of incidents. Develop security automations and workflows using scripting languages Python or Bash. Collaborate with the Threat Detection team to fine tune alerts and improve detection coverage. Contribute to IR playbooks, runbooks and post incident reviews. Qualifications 4 to 7 years of experience in cybersecurity with exposure to enterprise security, threat hunting and incident response. Hands on with security platforms like EDR, DLP, Wazuh, Vulnerability Management, and Cloudflare WAF. Good understanding of adversary tactics like MITRE ATT&CK, TTPs, IOC handling. Working knowledge of scripting/automation (Python, Bash, PowerShell). Knowledge of forensic techniques, log analysis, and security monitoring platforms. Strong grasp of enterprise IT & SaaS security (GSuite, VPNs, cloud security, IAM). Preferred certifications: Security+, CCNA/P, GIAC (GCIA/GCTI/GCIH) or equivalent. Experience in Fintech or financial services is a plus. Behavioral & Soft Skills Ownership mindset: can lead initiatives independently with minimal supervision. Strong analytical and problem solving skills in high-pressure situations. Excellent communicator and be able to explain technical security concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Team player that collaborates effectively across IT, engineering and security. Passionate about continuous learning, automation and staying current with the threat landscape.

review_candidates.location: Qesm El Obour, Al Qalyubiyah, Egypt
review_candidates.description: Job Summary We are looking for an experienced Odoo System Admin to manage, maintain, and optimize the company's Odoo ERP system. The role will be responsible for ensuring the system's stability, security, user support, and efficient utilization across all departments, while continuously improving business processes and system performance. The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience with Odoo administration and a good understanding of business processes within a manufacturing environment . Key Responsibilities Administer and maintain the Odoo ERP system and ensure its smooth day-to-day operation. Manage users, roles, access rights, permissions, and security settings. Configure Odoo modules, workflows, approval rules, and system settings according to business requirements. Provide first-line technical and functional support to Odoo users across different departments. Troubleshoot system issues, identify root causes, and ensure timely resolution. Monitor system performance, availability, and overall functionality. Coordinate with Odoo developers, implementation partners, and vendors when advanced technical support is required. Gather and analyze business requirements from different departments and translate them into Odoo system solutions. Support the implementation and optimization of Odoo modules and new functionalities. Monitor and improve existing workflows to increase efficiency and reduce manual processes. Support integration between Odoo and other systems when required. Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and integrity across the system. Monitor system backups and coordinate with the IT team to ensure data security and recovery procedures. Prepare and maintain system documentation, configurations, workflows, and user manuals. Provide training and guidance to users on Odoo functionalities and best practices. Monitor user activities and ensure compliance with system access policies. Support system upgrades, testing, and deployment of new features. Prepare regular reports on system performance, issues, and improvements. Identify opportunities for process automation and digital transformation using Odoo. Work closely with Finance, Production, Procurement, Warehouse, Sales, HR, and other departments to improve system utilization and business processes. Job Requirements Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related field. 3–7 years of hands-on experience in Odoo administration. Strong practical knowledge of Odoo ERP and its core modules. Experience with Odoo modules such as Accounting, Sales, Purchase, Inventory, Manufacturing (MRP), HR, and CRM . Strong understanding of ERP workflows and business processes. Experience managing users, access rights, security groups, and permissions. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Experience in Odoo configuration and customization from a functional perspective. Good understanding of databases and SQL. Knowledge of Python and Odoo technical architecture is a plus. Experience with Odoo APIs and third-party integrations is a plus. Previous experience in Manufacturing/FMCG is highly preferred. Strong analytical and organizational skills. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to work with both technical and non-technical users. Ability to manage multiple priorities and work under pressure. Good command of English.

review_candidates.title: Hard RT Embedded Software Infrastructure Engineer
review_candidates.description: About the Role The Missiles & Space Division is looking for a Hard RT Embedded Software Infrastructure Engineer. The role includes: • Development and maintenance of drivers and low-level system software components in C/C++. • Implementation and maintenance of various communication protocols, such as UART, SPI, CAN, Ethernet, and more. • Working in Hard Real-Time environments and Bare Metal systems, including in-depth understanding of operating systems such as FreeRTOS and VxWorks, as well as systems running without an OS. • Analysis, writing, and execution of system requirements, including design and testing (unit, integration, and system). • Real-time performance optimization, system integration, and integration of software and hardware components. • Collaboration with System Engineers, Test Engineers, Hardware Engineers, FPGA Engineers, and Project Managers throughout the entire product lifecycle – from specification definition through integration at the customer site. • Writing development documentation, including technical specifications, design documents, and test documentation. What We're Looking For • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science / Software Engineering / Electronics Engineering / Exact Sciences – Mandatory. • At least 3 years of experience in Hard Real-Time systems development – Mandatory. • Proven experience in software development using FreeRTOS – Mandatory. • High motivation, strong systems-level thinking, ability to work in a team, and excellent interpersonal skills – Mandatory. • Experience working with hardware components, interfaces, and communication protocols – Significant Advantage. • Experience in the development, integration, and testing of Real-Time Embedded systems – Advantage. • Ability to independently lead the development of a system from defining requirements through final testing and implementation at the customer site – Advantage. • Experience writing development documentation (specifications, design, and testing) – Advantage. • Understanding of Low-Level software layers, including direct hardware access, operating system integration, and development of application APIs for access to hardware and system services – Advantage. You Might Be Interested to Know Malam is our leading site for development, design, and systems engineering. The site combines extensive experience, knowledge, and capabilities to leverage cutting-edge technology into some of the world's most advanced products. Our product portfolio includes air defense and missile defense systems, space and launch technologies, command and control systems, precision strike, and simulation and training. With extensive experience working with governments and armed forces around the world, we provide comprehensive solutions – from the earliest stages of concept analysis, through research and development, manufacturing and installation, implementation, and ongoing support.

review_candidates.title: Director of Cloud
review_candidates.description: Kestra Financial is a wealth management platform dedicated to empowering independent financial professionals—including traditional and hybrid RIAs—to grow their businesses and deliver exceptional client service. We combine advanced business management technology with personalized consulting to provide unmatched scale, efficiency, and support. Our advisor-focused culture is built on innovation and advocacy, enabling advisors to offer comprehensive securities and investment advisory solutions to their clients Lead with Purpose. Partner with Impact. We are seeking a Director of Cloud & Platform Engineering to lead and mature our cloud platform organization. This leader will own the strategy, architecture, operations, and reliability of Kestra's Azure cloud environment and will be accountable for evolving the team from reactive infrastructure operations into a modern, service-oriented, SRE-aligned platform engineering function. This is a newly created leadership role reporting directly to the Head of IT Infrastructure & Cybersecurity, with direct oversight of the Cloud Platform team (currently led by the Manager of Platform Engineering) and associated platform engineers. What you’ll Do: Cloud Strategy & Architecture: Define and execute the cloud platform strategy for Kestra Holdings, aligned with business objectives, regulatory requirements, and the enterprise technology roadmap. Own the Azure landing zone architecture, subscription hierarchy, governance policies, and hybrid connectivity patterns. Drive the adoption of the Azure Well-Architected Framework and formalize governance through an Azure Governance body. Partner with Software Engineering, Data & AI, and Cybersecurity leadership to ensure platform decisions support cross-functional needs. FinOps & Cloud Economics: Own the FinOps discipline for Azure, including cost visibility, tagging governance, chargeback/showback models, and spend optimization. Drive year-over-year cloud cost efficiency targets while supporting business growth. Platform Engineering & Reliability: Transition the Cloud Platform function toward a service-based, SRE-aligned operating model—defining services, SLIs/SLOs, incident discipline, and toil reduction. Establish and publish service catalogs, support expectations, and escalation paths for all platform services (compute, storage, networking, data services, DR). Implement blameless postmortems, reliability improvement backlogs, and automation-first operational practices. Governance, Risk & Compliance: Ensure cloud platform operations align with NIST CSF 2.0 maturity targets and support the firm's cybersecurity roadmap. Partner with the CISO and Cybersecurity team on identity governance (Azure AD, RBAC, PIM), network segmentation, and security controls within the Azure environment. Support regulatory and audit requirements appropriate for a SEC-regulated financial services firm (e.g., data residency, access controls, logging/retention). Team Leadership & Development: Lead, mentor, and grow the Cloud Platform team, including platform engineers, associate engineers, and contractors located in both US and India offices Build a talent pipeline and workforce plan to support growth—balancing FTE, contractor, and managed service resources. Foster a culture of continuous learning, operational excellence, and accountability. Stakeholder & Vendor Management: Serve as the primary technical liaison for Microsoft (Azure account team) and key cloud vendors/partners. Represent Cloud/Platform in the Architecture Review Board, IT Change Management Board, and Azure Strategy Governance forums. Provide regular reporting to SVP and executive leadership on platform health, spend, risk posture, and strategic initiatives. Work together with other engineering organizations including Advisor platform, Data, and Dev on cross-team initiatives What You Bring: 15+ years in cloud engineering, infrastructure, or platform engineering roles, with 5+ years in a people leadership capacity (Director or Sr. Manager level) managing a global workforkforce Deep Azure expertise: landing zones, subscription management, Azure Policy, Entra ID (Azure AD), RBAC, PIM, networking (VNets, NSGs, private endpoints, ExpressRoute/VPN), and compute/storage/data services. Proven experience building and operating a platform engineering or SRE function—service ownership, SLOs, incident management, and toil reduction. Strong FinOps acumen: demonstrated success managing and optimizing cloud spend at scale ($5M+). Experience operating in a regulated industry (financial services, healthcare, or similar) with familiarity with compliance frameworks (NIST CSF, SOC 2, SEC, FINRA). Excellent communication skills—able to present cloud strategy, risk, and spend to executive and board-level audiences. Experience with IaC (Terraform, Bicep, ARM), CI/CD pipelines, and modern DevOps practices. Internal Application Policy: Internal applicants must be in good standing and have a minimum of 1 year of service with Kestra. Internal applicants must also have a minimum of 1 year service in current role unless approved by EVP. Benefits to support you: Competitive pay and benefits with a large employer (over 1600 employees nationwide) 401(k), health insurance, and a competitive benefits package Work in a supportive, collaborative environment committed to professional excellence Help clients navigate meaningful financial decisions with confidence Opportunities for training, development, and long-term growth within the firm Tuition reimbursement for qualified expenses Kestra Values: Our Mission is Powering Financial Independence, enabling the growth and success of investing clients and the advisors who serve them. We do that by living our values: Serve, Make it Happen, and One team. Apply now and help shape the future of Kestra.
